title: Paul writes to clergy to cultivate humility
english: In this letter Paul writes to clergy, not to laity. For this reason he did not need many moral corrections. His concern through the letter is that humility be set right among them. By the very advice he gives, he shows how exact their conduct is in every other respect. For it is rare for someone both to sin and to be proud. Pride takes hold of those who live the best lives and who, for that very reason, are usually lifted up by it.
Everywhere and through everything Paul shows that his sufferings and his defenses are not without profit. From your faith, he says, I make your steadfastness my proof (Philippians 1:7).
